title: Halfway House

vibeProfile.oneLine: A middle-class marriage laid bare, in a landmark Hindi play.

summary: Halfway House is the English title of Aadhe Adhure, Mohan Rakesh's landmark Hindi play and one of the most important works of modern Indian theatre. Set in a cramped urban household, it lays bare the frustrations and failures of a middle-class family, above all a marriage and a woman's unmet longings, with unsparing realism. Pioneering in its frank treatment of domestic discontent, it broke new ground for Hindi drama and remains widely staged and studied.
whyReadIt: Mohan Rakesh's landmark Hindi play, an unsparing look at a middle-class marriage and a woman's unmet longings.

funFacts.text: Aadhe Adhure is considered a foundational text of modern Hindi theatre.
